title: When Home Feels Like Fear Instead of Peace: My Personal Journey
message: New blog: When Home Feels Like Fear Instead of Peace: My Personal Journey

socialPromo.headline: When Home Feels Like Fear
socialPromo.subhead: My personal journey through parental criticism and the search for emotional safety.
socialPromo.scene: A young man, Farhan (18-20 years old, South Asian appearance), sits hunched over a desk in a dimly lit room, illuminated only by the faint glow of a laptop screen, which is currently off and placed just out of reach. His expression is thoughtful and slightly melancholic, reflecting a mix of frustration and quiet determination. In the background, a slightly open door reveals a brighter, active family living space, suggesting proximity but also distance. The composition emphasizes his isolation and the barrier between his internal world of ideas (represented by the laptop) and the external family environment. The mood is introspective and slightly tense, with shadows playing around him, symbol
socialPromo.caption: Jab apna ghar sukoon ki bajaye darr ki wajah ban jaye... Ek builder Farhan Balouch ki kahani, jo apne walid ki tanqeed aur laptop cheenay jaane ke baad, emotional safety aur apni pehchan ki talaash mein hai. Kya aap bhi aisi situations se guzre hain?
